description: Ritual of Summoning 300 Mana 30 yd range 5 sec cast Requires Warlock Requires level 20 Reagents: Soul Shard Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.
name: Ritual of Summoning
